title: Browsers, servers, and requests
goals: Describe the path from typing a URL to seeing a page
Distinguish browser, DNS, and web server roles
Read a simple HTTP status code
bodyMd:
## What happens when you hit Enter?

When you type a URL and press Enter, the browser follows DNS, TCP/TLS, HTTP request, response, and render. Status codes 200, 404, and 500 are the ones you will meet first.

practice.prompt: Run curl -I against any public site and note the status line.
practice.solution: HTTP/2 200 and a content-type such as text/html.

quiz.question: What does DNS primarily do?
choices: Map a host name to an IP address

video.script: Walk the path from address bar to HTML on screen.
